other_text: Neighborhood séance, astrological reading, Ouija boards. Innocent entertainment? Or . . . A hard-hitting investigation that shows how involvement with the supernatural and occult can be the entrance to sinister worlds of evil, deception and destruction.
moderation_notes: Contains themes related to the occult and supernatural, which may be sensitive to some audiences.
description: A dark, eerie poster featuring a glowing crystal ball with tarot imagery and text about supernatural dangers.
